light_description: NERDS 15th-anniversary distortion using an LM741 op-amp and a RAT-derived circuit with a three-stage gain switch.
NERDS distortion using TL072 and a tuned Maestro MFZ-based concept for full-drive 1970s American-rock tones.
NERDS distortion using TL081 and a tuned DeArmond square-wave concept with bright harmonic emphasis.
NERDS distortion using Mitsubishi M5223 and a tuned vintage Ross distortion concept.
NERDS distortion using CA3260 and a tuned 1980s Ibanez MT10 concept, with three-band EQ.
NERDS overdrive using TL081 and a tuned 1970s DOD FX50 concept; intended for natural crunch or boost use.
NERDS overdrive using TL061 and a tuned Hot Cake concept, with gain/presence/volume controls.
NERDS overdrive using UPC4558 and a tuned boutique TS9 concept with the buffer removed for touch response.
NERDS overdrive using MC4558 and a tuned Zen Drive concept with smooth drive response and Voice control.
NERDS overdrive using MC1458 and a tuned 1970s Ibanez Dirt Box concept.
NERDS FET overdrive using three BS170 devices and a tuned Box of Rock concept for amp-like response.
NERDS overdrive using CD4049UBE with a two-way gain switch and tube-amp-like response.
NERDS bass overdrive using transistor/FET gain stages with a two-way gain switch while preserving bass bottom end.
NERDS simple transistor overdrive using a single 2N3904 for an uncolored drive response.
NERDS overdrive using LA6458 with a 2SD77 germanium transistor buffer, tuned for vintage character and modern response.
NERDS overdrive using OPA2604AP and a tuned Fulltone-based concept with a two-way gain switch.
NERDS fuzz using two BC108 transistors and a tuned vintage Colorsound-style voicing.
NERDS 3-volt fuzz using three AC128 transistors and a tuned Maestro FZ-1 concept.
NERDS LM386-based fuzz with Volume, Gain and Texture controls and a broad fuzz range.
NERDS fuzz using two 2N3642 transistors with a Little Muff-style character.
NERDS octave fuzz tuned from a vintage Foxx Tone Machine concept, with Range switching.
NERDS octave fuzz tuned from a vintage Octavia concept with Volume and Boost controls.
NERDS fuzz using two BC109 transistors and a tuned Fuzz Face concept with Gain, Contour and Bias controls.
NERDS fuzz using two 2SC1000 transistors and a tuned 1960s AstroTone concept.
NERDS updated Mad Fuzz variant using four 2SC1815 transistors with a gain switch.
NERDS hybrid fuzz-drive combining the Mad Fuzz concept with a 1970s Ibanez OD850 reference.
NERDS hybrid fuzz combining Mad Fuzz with a vintage Jumbo Tone Bender concept using 2SC693 devices.
NERDS Mad Fuzz variant tuned from early hand-wired Big Muff references using 2SC693 transistors.
NERDS bass-tuned Mad Fuzz using BC549 transistors for preserved low-end response.
NERDS Dope Fuzz retuned with two 2N3642 transistors and reduced gain for a distinct fuzz voice.
NERDS updated ISO Fuzz using 2SC828 with added gain switching.
NERDS ISO Fuzz variant using 2SC1000 transistors for an early-Japanese fuzz character.
